Note::TexAccessor::strip_figs¶

Back to Note TeX Accessor API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::TexAccessor::strip_figs() const

Remove Figure Regions, Not Graphic Calls¶

strip_figs() removes complete figure, figure*, wrapfigure, and subfigure environments. It exists for source whose figure bodies, captions, labels, and placement machinery should disappear as a unit. A standalone \includegraphics{...} call is intentionally retained; choose strip_graphics() when both figure containers and direct graphic inclusions must be removed.

Each supported environment is matched by its exact name. Same-name nested regions are depth balanced, so an inner figure cannot close an outer one. Starred and unstarred names are distinct. Escaped openers and unterminated regions remain unchanged, while complete regions elsewhere in the same cell are still removed.

The operation collapses ASCII whitespace around removed regions, allocates a new Text Note, and preserves rank, shape, and cell order. It is idempotent and does not inspect image files or resolve paths. Undefined input stays undefined; all defined non-Text dtypes reject. Runtime is linear for each fixed set of four environment names.

Example 1: Nested And Variant Figure Regions¶

const auto source = pluss::make_note({
    R"(A \begin{figure}outer \begin{figure}inner\end{figure} tail\end{figure} B)",
    R"(C \begin{figure*}wide\end{figure*} D \begin{wrapfigure}wrap\end{wrapfigure} E)",
    R"(\includegraphics{kept.png} \begin{figure}unfinished)"});
const auto clean = source.tex().strip_figs();
std::cout << clean << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[3], dim=1, numel=3, encoding=utf8)
["A B", "C D E", "\\includegraphics{kept.png} \\begin{figure}unfinished"]

Example 2: A Scalar subfigure¶

std::cout << pluss::make_note(
    R"(A \begin{subfigure}part\end{subfigure} B)").tex().strip_figs() << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
"A B"

A scalar Note remains rank zero. The method transforms cells; it does not promote scalar input into a collection.

Example 3: Idempotence, Undefined State, And Dtype¶

const auto once = pluss::make_note(
    R"(A \begin{figure}body\end{figure} B)").tex().strip_figs();
std::cout << std::boolalpha
          << "idempotent=" << ((once == once.tex().strip_figs()).all().bool_item())
          << " undefined="
          << pluss::Note::undefined().tex().strip_figs().defined() << '\n';
try {
  (void)pluss::note::make(std::vector<std::int64_t>{1}).tex().strip_figs();
} catch (const pluss::Error&) {
  std::cout << "strip figs Int64: rejected\n";
}

Output¶

idempotent=true undefined=false
strip figs Int64: rejected
